feedback.Physical Object: Included — A discrete, bounded vehicle with physical dimensions.
feedback.Biological/Biomimetic: Excluded — May resemble flight behavior but not directly inspired structurally by biology.
feedback.Powered: Included — Requires an onboard power supply to operate.
feedback.Structural: Included — Frame and airframe provide support and shape.
feedback.Observable: Included — Visible and trackable both visually and by sensors.
feedback.Active: Included — Executes autonomous movement and decision routines.
feedback.Intentionally Designed: Included — Built with purpose to navigate, record, or deliver.
feedback.Outputs Effect: Included — Produces motion, sometimes sound, visual signals, or payload deployment.
feedback.Processes Signals/Logic: Included — Interprets data from GPS, sensors, and internal software.
feedback.State-Transforming: Included — Alters position, configuration, and possibly sensor states.
feedback.Human-Interactive: Excluded — While often piloted or supervised, autonomous function is core.
feedback.System-integrated: Included — Operates as part of control systems or logistical networks.
feedback.Functionally Autonomous: Included — Capable of independent operation and re-routing.
feedback.System-Essential: Excluded — Not critical to system identity; interchangeable.
feedback.Signalling: Included — Transmits telemetry and control data to systems and operators.
feedback.Rule-governed: Included — Operates under programmed constraints and airspace rules.
feedback.Compositional: Included — Constructed of interdependent modules and subsystems.
feedback.Meta: Excluded — Does not reference its own conceptual form.
feedback.Temporal: Included — Navigation and scheduling depend on time-based planning.
feedback.Digital/Virtual: Included — Autonomous operation depends entirely on internal software and digital logic.
feedback.Social Construct: Excluded — Has physical reality regardless of social consensus.
feedback.Institutionally Defined: Excluded — May be regulated but not defined by institution.
feedback.Identity-Linked: Excluded — Not inherently tied to individual or group identity.
feedback.Regulated: Included — Subject to laws and guidelines for airspace and safety.
feedback.Economically Significant: Included — Key contributor to multiple commercial and industrial sectors.
feedback.Politicised: Included — Subject of intense debate over military, surveillance, and privacy issues.
feedback.Ritualised: Excluded — Not part of structured cultural ritual.
feedback.Ethically Significant: Included — Raises substantial ethical questions regarding autonomous action, targeting, and surveillance.

encoding_notes: This encoding reflects the autonomous drone as a cyber-physical, programmable system operating under digital control and with substantial real-world implications. Abstract and social traits are selected to reflect both technical structure and social impact. Invalid traits have been removed.
